_comment: Ground truth from Factorio's POINT basis_noise kernel through calculate_tile_properties, Version: 2.1.20 (build 87512, mac-arm64, steam). Points sit on lattice rows (noise dy = 0) or columns (noise dx = 0), a tiny step off a corner, so a corner whose gradient slot has a near-zero component returns that component to full f32 precision (#455). x[n], y[n] are WORLD positions; the noise point is (x * inputScale, y * inputScale), exact in f32 and f64. Each case's values[n] is basis_noise at point n, output_scale 1. The last 16 points are lattice points at every case's scale and must be exactly 0. Cross-checked: Version: 2.0.77 (build 84539, mac-arm64, full) returned bit-identical values. Captured by scripts/probes/basis-axis/capture.ts.
